fields.acceptance: A passing CI run's log shows the roadmap and ready medians for as-is and to-be.
fields.statement: CI prints the read-budget timings (median, min and max per read and view) on every run, passing or failing, so the runner's numbers are on record.

fields.acceptance: Three consecutive CI runs on the PR each print roadmap and ready medians under 25 ms, and TestReadBudget's budget is still 50 ms.
fields.statement: On GitHub's runner, roadmap and ready on the 50,000-node model have a median under 25 ms in every view, half the 50 ms budget, which is unchanged.
